newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wong's to launch Singapore spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Wong's to launch Singapore spin-off.

text.p: Wong's International (Holdings) Ltd said on Wednesday it would launch an offering in Singapore of 29 million new shares and 14 million existing shares in its Wong's Circuits (Holdings) Ltd unit at US$0.88 per share.

The company said in a statement that of the 43 million shares, 34.4 million, or 20.6 percent of Wong's Circuits' enlarged issued share capital, would be privately placed with investors in Singapore at US$0.88 per share.
The remaining 8.6 million shares, or 5.1 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of Wong's Circuits, would be offered in a public offering at US$0.88 per share.
The offer price represents a weighted average price earnings ratio of 7.3 times Wong's Circuits estimated earnings for the year ending December 31, Wong's International said.

It said the offering would begin on November 28 and the application period for the public offering would close on December 10. Dealing in the shares on the Stock Exchange of Singapore is due to begin on or around December 12.
Wong's International said after the offering it would own about 74.3 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of Wong's Circuits, its printed circuit board operation.
